a50:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: tiny pixel-art game character sprite strip, three static orientations of the SAME approved Shiba.
Input 1 is the approved v1 game sprite to edit for tiny-size readability. Input 2 is the adopted original Shiba identity and three directions, not a new dog design.
Preserve orange/tan fur, creamy white muzzle/chest/paws/eyebrows, black nose/eyes, erect ears with pink inside, curled tail with cream tip, friendly face. Keep the accepted v1 simple warm pixel art and compact proportions.
Produce ONE ROW of THREE clearly separated sprites: LEFT is RIGHT-FACING side profile; MIDDLE is LEFT-FACING side profile; RIGHT is FRONT-FACING standing pose. All are exactly the same bodily scale and same paw baseline. No walk animation. Side profiles should match in body length, head/ear height and paw size. Front uses the same head size and height, naturally narrower. Tail can be obscured in front view. Front mouth small friendly opening, tiny pink tongue, as the source.
STRICT TINY PIXEL ART: Redesign pixel clusters to be readable as an approximately 21 wide by 22 tall side sprite; front approximately 14 wide by 22 tall. This is a 50% BODY linear-size candidate, not percent canvas or area. Visibly simple shapes, ONE dark-brown logical pixel outer contour; eye a 1-pixel dark mark, nose separate at tip, one clearly separated mouth mark, cream muzzle stays intact; each paw readable with a transparent gap between forelegs and hindlegs. No fine fur, no dithering, no extra small highlights. At this native size every individual pixel counts.
Show the pixel art at a large exact nearest-neighbor enlargement, uniform big square pixels without anti-aliasing, smooth gradients or painted texture. Each sprite can sit in a 48x48 logical transparent cell with the sole baseline y44 and center x24; empty space above is required because the dog is much smaller than the frame. Three cells across, right/left/front. Request canvas 1440x480 (10x enlarged). Same upper-left illumination for all three poses. Flat limited palette of warm orange, cream, brown shadow, dark-brown outline, black eye/nose and restrained pink.
Actual RGBA transparent background including between legs; KEEP WHITE FUR OPAQUE. No white rim, shadow, floor, text, labels, panel boundaries, scale legend, grid or checkerboard. No human, no other animal. Preserve adopted dog identity; only tiny-size pixel simplification and pose consistency may change.
